title: Gen-EE
fill_note: DENSE layered wind with a jig; scorer cap 0.65
fill_how: The scored turns assume a dense, layer-by-layer wind at fill 0.65 (insulated-wire area / window; the scorer cap). Use a winding jig on a drill/lathe with a turn counter, lay each layer side-by-side with light back-tension, and do not scramble-wind: a scramble wind only reaches ≈0.55–0.60 and then the window holds fewer turns (scorer what-if `--fill 0.60` is in the table above). Never wind more than the listed turns — the copper must stay below the flanges.
steel_extra: **New steel:** Ø992 discs, M3 clamp map R30 at 0/90/180/270° and R44 on the inter-pole angles 67.5/112.5/247.5/292.5° (both inside the R460 magnet ring). Cut from this kit's `steel_backiron_disc.dxf`; no earlier disc fits.
o5_note: 48 O5x5 used as AXIAL POLE EXTENDERS IN LINE with the pole, 3 per pole per rotor (2 on the pole axis just outside the N42 block at R484.25 and R490.4 + 1 on the pole axis just inside the N52 bar's inner end at R385.75), same polarity as the pole — NOT Halbach assists (no inter-pole Ø5). AXIAL O5: stand upright. DIAMETRIC O5: lay on its side (axis tangential) with the pole-letter side up — both fit the 5.3 mm square pocket; the scorer counts them either way (upright scored, lying what-if reported). If your Ø5 are neither axial nor diametric (unknown magnetisation), leave them out and expect a lower score (no-Ø5 what-if reported).
card_title: Gen-EE · IN-LINE Ø5 pole at R460 · pedestal frame · 12-segment split stator · 24 AWG
card_sub: Ø5 @R385.75 + N52 bar RADIAL @R419.4 + Ø20 @R460 + N42 + 2 Ø5 IN LINE · bobbins r384–494 × 4.4 mm · 7.00 mm gap · 2× Ø992 steel · 2026-11-05
idea: Same Gen-EB in-line Ø5 pole grown to R460 — past the 6-seg bed limit — by splitting the stator into 12 × 30° half-lap segments (1 bay each); ≈26 mm-chord bobbins r384–494 on the 390 m 24 AWG spool; higher surface speed is the gain.
steel_note: Steel: 2× Ø992 × 4.76 mm (3/16") mild-steel discs, clamp map hub M3 at R22 0/90/180/270°, 4× Ø4.3 brace holes R18 at 45/135/225/315°, 16 arc-clamp M3 at R460 ±13° from every pole, index notch at +X — cut from this kit's `steel_backiron_disc.dxf` (laser-cut service, or any shop that cuts 3/16" mild steel; fits a 4×8 ft sheet). Each disc weighs ≈28.9 kg. Lobed arcs: 2.4 mm PLA around each pocket; the epoxy-to-steel bond, not the PLA, holds the magnets. NEW discs (Ø992); no earlier disc fits. Gen-EG uses the SAME discs and arcs.
retro_md:
## Modular notes (Gen-EE)

New rotors (Ø992 steel, arcs at R460), a new 12-segment split stator and the pedestal frame sized for this radius. **Gen-EG is a drop-in alternative stator for these same rotors** (scramble-wind friendly, fill 0.60). **From a Gen-EB (or Gen-DZ) build you re-use:** all 16 Ø20, 16 N42 blocks, 16 N52 bars and 48 Ø5 (pop them out of the old arcs), the 8 mm shaft, 608RS bearings, collars, base pedestal design; the 390 m of 24 AWG can be unwound and re-wound if the enamel is undamaged (otherwise a new spool). New: steel discs, arcs, 12-segment stator, posts/spider sized for this radius, bigger base board. Swap stators/rotors with the 4 temporary M4 jack rods: raise rotor B on the nuts (clap hazard in reverse, never by hand), swap the part, lower rotor B, remove the rods.
halb_block:
halbach_magnetisation = "none";  // NO inter-pole Halbach O5 in this kit: all 48 O5x5 are AXIAL POLE EXTENDERS (pole_o5_*)
rotor_b_same_axis   = true;     // same-index magnets share one axis: N faces S across the gap
small_block:
small_r_list        = [];       // no O5 pockets
// --- N42 rectangular BLOCK magnets (2026-10-16/18): one 20x10x5 block per pole on the pole angle, next to the O20 disc ---
block_R_list        = [475.6];   // block centre radius (pole angle); same polarity as its O20 -> radially extended pole (scorer position = pushed-apart magnet centre)
block_angle_list    = [0];
block_radial        = 10.0;    // block side that runs RADIALLY (mm)
block_tangential    = 20.0;    // block side that runs TANGENTIALLY (mm)
block_h             = 5.0;     // magnetised through the 5 mm thickness (axial), = magnet_h_large so it sits on the steel
block_Br            = 1.29;    // N42 remanence (1.28-1.32 T); scorer models it as a magpylib Cuboid
block_pocket_clear  = 0.3;    // pocket = block + 0.3 mm each way (+ 1.2 mm corner reliefs)
keyhole_pocket      = true;     // 2026-10-18: disc + block share ONE keyhole pocket (hull); they repel onto the far walls
disc_pocket_shift   = 0.00;    // disc pocket centre offset (radial) so the pushed-apart disc sits at R_large
block_pocket_shift  = -0.15;    // block pocket centre offset so the pushed-apart block sits at block_R_list (scorer position)
// --- N52 60x10x3 BARS (2026-10-30 RADIAL-IN, physics_scorer block2 group): one per pole, RADIALLY INSIDE the O20, 60 mm side RADIAL ---
block2_R_list       = [419.4];   // bar centre radius (pushed onto the INNER pocket wall by its disc)
block2_angle_list   = [0];
block2_radial       = 60.0;     // bar 60 mm side RADIAL (along the pole axis)
block2_tangential   = 10.0;     // bar 10 mm side tangential
block2_h            = 3.0;      // magnetised through the 3 mm thickness (axial); gap face FLUSH with the disc face
block2_Br           = 1.43;     // N52
block2_pocket_clear = 0.3;
block2_pocket_depth = 3.05;     // BLIND pocket from the stator face: bar sits on a 1.95 mm PLA floor over the steel
block2_pocket_shift = 0.15;     // pocket centre +0.15 -> inner wall at R - 30.0 (pushed-in bar sits exactly at block2_R_list)
block2_merge_in     = 0.0;
block2_merge_out    = 0.45;     // pocket OUTER wall extended outward so it opens into the disc pocket (no PLA sliver)
eng_a = 4.6; eng_L = 5.0; eng_ta = 4.6; eng_tr = 0;   // engraving: N/S pole letter on the spine (no Halbach arrows; 2026-10-26 axial O5)
// --- O5x5 AXIAL POLE EXTENDERS (2026-10-26, physics_scorer pole_o5 group): 3 per pole, same polarity as the pole's disc ---
pole_o5_R_list      = [484.250, 490.400, 385.750];   // centre radius of each O5 (pole frame)
pole_o5_angle_list  = [0.0000, 0.0000, 0.0000];   // angle offset from the pole (deg)
pole_o5_mode        = "upright";   // scored as UPRIGHT axial O5x5 (lying diametric O5 scored as a what-if: within 0.05 %)
pole_o5_d           = 5.0;
pole_o5_h           = 5.0;
pole_o5_pocket      = 5.3;      // SQUARE through-pocket 5.3 x 5.3 (fits an upright O5x5 OR one lying on its side), 1.2 mm corner reliefs
seg_block:
stator_n_seg        = 12;        // 2026-11-01: SPLIT stator, 12 segments (A,B,A,B) joined by half-laps (stator > 410 mm bed)
stator_seg_j0       = 15;      // first joint angle = mid-angle between coil stations 0 and 1
stator_lap_deg      = 6;      // half-lap half-width (deg) either side of a joint; web left to the nearest bay >= 1.2 mm
stator_lap_pin_r    = [392.0, 486.0];   // 1.75 mm filament pins through each lap; + 1x M3 at R flange_bolt_r
